definitions.gloss: feeding wild animals or birds; taming by feeding
definitions.explanation: The act of regularly providing food to wild animals or birds, either to tame them or as a habitual practice. Can also refer to training animals to come to a specific location through feeding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野良猫|のらねこ}→野良猫：14440_noraneko⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{餌付|えづ}け⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Feeding stray cats in the park is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{野生動物|やせいどうぶつ}→野生動物：09251_yaseidoubutsu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{餌付|えづ}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Feeding of wild animals by tourists has become a problem.

notes:
Composed of {餌|え} (bait/feed) + ⟦{付|つ}け→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (attaching/applying). Refers to regularly feeding wild animals, often to tame them or attract them to a location.

USAGE:
Used as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb: {餌付|えづ}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The object is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{鳩|はと}→鳩：05007_hato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{餌付|えづ}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to feed pigeons).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {餌付|えづ}け⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no feeding (common sign in parks)
- ⟦{野生動物|やせいどうぶつ}→野生動物：09251_yaseidoubutsu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{餌付|えづ}け: feeding wild animals
- {餌付|えづ}け⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feed (wild animals)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In many Japanese parks and nature reserves, {餌付|えづ}け is prohibited because it disrupts animals' natural behavior and can make them dependent on humans. Signs reading {餌付|えづ}け⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ are common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{餌|えさ}やり→餌やり：22010_esayari⟧: feeding (more general, including pets)
- {給餌|きゅうじ}: feeding (technical/formal)
